name: qtim
description: Codex-native bootstrap and orchestration kit for project-specific subagent teams. Includes setup, team-up, team-lazy, team-down skills, custom agent templates, intake rules, orchestration patterns, independent review gates, and lifecycle hooks.

interface.longDescription: qtim adapts a project into a Codex-native team workflow: it generates .codex/team-charter.md, custom .codex/agents/*.toml roles, project memory, hooks, and reusable skills for full-team, lazy-team, and teardown flows.
defaultPrompt: Set up qtim for this project
Run qtim team-up for this epic
Use qtim team-lazy for this task
